name: astryx
description: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
one_liner: A free, ready-made set of 150+ polished app building-blocks (buttons, forms, themes) so a team doesn't have to design and build their own interface from scratch.
buyer: A startup founder or freelance frontend developer who needs a professional-looking app fast and can't afford months of custom design work.
business_use_cases: A solo developer builds and launches a client's MVP dashboard in days instead of weeks by styling Astryx's components instead of building a UI from scratch.
A design agency offers a fixed-price 'launch-ready app in 2 weeks' package built entirely on Astryx themes, undercutting competitors who quote custom design timelines.
A no-code-adjacent freelancer sells pre-themed Astryx 'starter kits' (SaaS dashboard, marketing site, admin panel) as templates on a marketplace.

money_ideas.idea: Sell pre-built, themed component bundles (dashboard, landing page, admin panel) as paid templates
Fixed-price 'ship your app's UI in two weeks' agency service built on Astryx

steal_this: Theme Astryx with one of its seven built-in themes, wire up a generic SaaS dashboard layout, and sell it this weekend as a ready-to-use starter template.
